assets.generationPrompt: Create a strictly geometric pixel-art calibration board, never a character or object with anatomy. On a transparent 64x64 canvas, arrange four separate palette swatches, one stepped corner sample, three horizontal value bars, and one staircase edge sample. Use a 32x32 logical grid, at most 16 warm colors, a one-logical-pixel dark chromatic outline rather than pure black, rounded two-to-four-pixel color clusters, and two-step coral, cream, teal, and muted-plum shading. Keep the samples visibly separate and aligned like a design-system chart. No face, eyes, body, feet, supports, tail, animal silhouette, mascot, text, logo, frame, shadow, anti-aliasing, blur, gradient, dithering, texture, or semi-transparent edge. Return only one RGBA PNG.
